### What does this PR do?

Fixes #7807. `MultiTurnSFTDataset` rendered each message in isolation with `apply_chat_template([message])`, but chat templates such as Qwen3 build the `<think>` block from `reasoning_content` only when the assistant message is rendered together with its preceding conversation. Per-message rendering therefore silently dropped the reasoning channel: `sanity_check()` raised `AssertionError` on reasoning conversations, and with `ignore_input_ids_mismatch=True` the trained sequence never contained any `<think>` section, which teaches the model to put final answers into the reasoning channel.

The fix uses the previously unused `full_message` argument: for conversations that carry a `reasoning_content` field, assistant turns are rendered as part of the conversation prefix (`full_message[:index+1]`), and the tokenized `full_message[:index]` prefix is sliced off to obtain the per-turn increment. Every other turn, and the whole VLM/processor path, keeps the previous per-message rendering, so token sequences stay byte-identical for conversations without `reasoning_content` and for templates without position-dependent rendering.

**Why this is not duplicating an existing PR (per AGENTS.md):** searched open PRs for [`7807`](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Aopen+7807) (0 hits), [`reasoning_content`](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Aopen+reasoning_content), and [`MultiTurnSFTDataset`](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Aopen+MultiTurnSFTDataset). The closest ones are #7322/#7700 (ContinuousTokenBuilder integration, a feature redesign that does not claim #7807) and #8153 (only adds test trajectories for `scripts/chat_template_checker.py`, explicitly not tied to any issue). The issue timeline shows no cross-references. This PR is a minimal bug fix on the current pipeline and does not conflict with those efforts.

**AI assistance disclosure:** this change was developed with the assistance of an AI coding agent. The submitting human reviewed every changed line, ran the duplicate-work checks above, and ran all tests below.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here:
  - https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Aopen+7807
  - https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Aopen+reasoning_content+in%3Atitle%2Cbody
  - https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Aopen+MultiTurnSFTDataset
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI)
  - Title: `[data] fix: preserve reasoning content in multi-turn SFT tokenization`
  - No breaking API change, so no `[BREAKING]` prefix.

### Test

All commands CPU-only (transformers 5.12.1, torch 2.14.1 CPU, macOS arm64, tokenizers under `~/models/`):

1. New regression test, red on `main`, green with this fix (Qwen3-0.6B):
```bash
python -m pytest -q tests/utils/dataset/test_multiturn_sft_qwen3_reasoning_on_cpu.py
# on main : 1 failed, 1 passed
#           (test_multiturn_sft_qwen3_reasoning_preserved[Qwen3-0.6B] fails with the
#            sanity_check AssertionError reported in #7807)
# with fix: 2 passed
#           (also asserts token-for-token equality with the previous implementation
#            on Qwen2.5-0.5B, i.e. no regression for non-position-dependent templates)
```
2. Existing tests stay green and unchanged:
```bash
python -m pytest -q "tests/utils/dataset/test_multiturn_sft_dataset_on_cpu.py::test_multiturn_sft_dataset" \
                    "tests/utils/dataset/test_multiturn_sft_dataset_on_cpu.py::test_multiturn_sft_dataset_with_chat_template_kwargs"
# 4 passed: Qwen2.5-0.5B (ignore=False), Qwen3-0.6B (ignore=True), Qwen3.5-0.8B (ignore=False), gpt-oss-20b
```
3. Pre-commit hooks on the changed files:
```bash
pre-commit run --files verl/utils/dataset/multiturn_sft_dataset.py tests/utils/dataset/test_multiturn_sft_qwen3_reasoning_on_cpu.py
# all 13 hooks Passed (ruff, ruff-format, mypy, autogen-trainer-cfg, docstring/license/structure checks, compileall)
```

### API and Usage Example

No API or config change. Behavior for a Qwen3 multi-turn conversation whose assistant messages carry `reasoning_content`:

```python
item = dataset[0]  # no longer raises AssertionError from sanity_check
# item["input_ids"] now equals tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
#     whole_conversation, tools=tools, enable_thinking=True)
# tokenizer.decode(item["input_ids"][item["loss_mask"] == 1]) contains
# "<think>reasoning ...</think>\n<tool_call>...</tool_call>" for every assistant turn,
# so ignore_input_ids_mismatch=True is no longer needed for this scenario.
```

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/utils/dataset/multiturn_sft_dataset.py` (`_process_single_message`): added a gated context-rendering branch (text-only path, `index != 0`, assistant role, conversation contains a truthy `reasoning_content`). It renders `full_message[:index+1]` via verl's `apply_chat_template` wrapper and slices off the tokenized `full_message[:index]` prefix; if the shorter prefix is not a token-level prefix of the longer render, it warns and slices by length (the existing `sanity_check` remains the final sequence oracle). `__getitem__` now passes `tools` ungated and the per-message branch applies the historical `tools if index == 0 else None` gating internally, keeping VLM behavior identical.
- New CPU test `tests/utils/dataset/test_multiturn_sft_qwen3_reasoning_on_cpu.py` (auto-picked-up by `cpu_unit_tests.yml`, which globs `**/*.py`).

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting): `pre-commit run --files <changed files>` all passed.
- [ ] Add / Update the documentation: no user-facing API/config change (bug fix only), so no doc update needed.
- [x] Add unit or end-to-end test(s) to the CI workflow: new `*_on_cpu.py` test is covered by `cpu_unit_tests.yml`.
- [ ] CI trigger: this is an external PR, so workflow runs need maintainer approval — could a maintainer please approve the workflows to run? (The Slack invite link is not accessible to me.)
- [x] Not related to the `recipe` submodule.

+"""
+Test that MultiTurnSFTDataset preserves the reasoning channel (`<think>` blocks built from
+`reasoning_content`) of intermediate assistant turns when tokenizing multi-turn conversations.
+
+Regression test for https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues/7807: rendering each message
+in isolation with `apply_chat_template([message])` drops the `<think>` block for Qwen3, because
+the template only renders it when the assistant message is rendered with preceding context.
+"""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pandas as pd
+import pytest
+import torch
+from transformers.utils import get_json_schema
+
+from verl.utils import hf_tokenizer
+from verl.utils.dataset.multiturn_sft_dataset import MultiTurnSFTDataset
+from verl.utils.tokenizer.chat_template import apply_chat_template
+
+custom_model_prefix = Path("~/models").expanduser().resolve()
+
+
+def find_parking(location: str):
+    """Find the nearest parking lot.
+
+    Args:
+        location: The place to search parking lots around.
+
+    Returns:
+        The coordinates of the nearest parking lot.
+    """
+    ...
+
+
+TOOLS = [get_json_schema(find_parking)]
+
+MESSAGES = [
+    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
+    {"role": "user", "content": "Where is the nearest parking lot?"},
+    {
+        "role": "assistant",
+        "content": "",
+        "reasoning_content": "User wants the nearest parking lot.",
+        "tool_calls": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "find_parking", "arguments": '{"location": "here"}'}}],
+    },
+    {"role": "tool", "content": "[34.0, -117.0]"},
+    {"role": "assistant", "content": "Parking is 100m ahead."},
+]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def reasoning_data_file(tmp_path):
+    test_file = tmp_path / "test_qwen3_reasoning.parquet"
+    pd.DataFrame({"messages": [MESSAGES], "tools": [TOOLS]}).to_parquet(test_file)
+    return str(test_file)
+
+
+def build_dataset(model_path: str, data_file: str, **config_overrides):
+    tokenizer = hf_tokenizer(model_path)
+    config = {
+        "max_length": 512,
+        "truncation": "error",
+        "pad_mode": "no_padding",
+        "messages_key": "messages",
+        "enable_thinking_default": True,
+        "ignore_input_ids_mismatch": False,
+    }
+    config.update(config_overrides)
+    dataset = MultiTurnSFTDataset(parquet_files=data_file, tokenizer=tokenizer, processor=None, config=config)
+    return tokenizer, dataset
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("model_path", [f"{custom_model_prefix}/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B"])
+def test_multiturn_sft_qwen3_reasoning_preserved(model_path, reasoning_data_file):
+    """With Qwen3, the concatenated sequence must keep the `<think>` block of every assistant
+    turn and equal a one-shot `apply_chat_template` over the whole conversation, without
+    resorting to `ignore_input_ids_mismatch=True`."""
+    tokenizer, dataset = build_dataset(model_path, reasoning_data_file)
+
+    # (a) default configuration: sanity_check must not raise
+    item = dataset[0]
+
+    input_ids = item["input_ids"]
+    loss_mask = item["loss_mask"]
+    supervised_text = tokenizer.decode(input_ids[loss_mask == 1])
+    non_supervised_text = tokenizer.decode(input_ids[loss_mask == 0])
+    print(f"Supervised text (loss_mask==1):\n{supervised_text}")
+    print(f"Non-supervised text (loss_mask==0):\n{non_supervised_text}")
+
+    # (b) both assistant turns are trained on, including their `<think>` blocks
+    assert supervised_text.count("<think>") == 2, f"Expected 2 <think> blocks, got: {supervised_text}"
+    assert "User wants the nearest parking lot." in supervised_text, (
+        "reasoning_content of the tool-call turn must be kept in the supervised tokens"
+    )
+    assert "<tool_call>" in supervised_text and "find_parking" in supervised_text
+    assert "Parking is 100m ahead." in supervised_text, "final assistant answer must be supervised"
+    assert "User wants the nearest parking lot." not in non_supervised_text, (
+        "reasoning_content must not leak into the non-supervised tokens"
+    )
+    assert "[34.0, -117.0]" in non_supervised_text, "tool response must stay non-supervised"
+
+    # (c) the concatenated sequence equals a one-shot render of the whole conversation
+    truth_ids = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
+        MESSAGES,
+        tools=TOOLS,
+        add_generation_prompt=False,
+        tokenize=True,
+        return_dict=True,
+        return_tensors="pt",
+        enable_thinking=True,
+    )["input_ids"].squeeze(0)
+    assert torch.equal(input_ids, truth_ids), (
+        "MultiTurnSFTDataset sequence must equal apply_chat_template on the whole conversation"
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("model_path", [f"{custom_model_prefix}/Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B"])
+def test_multiturn_sft_non_thinking_model_unchanged(model_path, reasoning_data_file):
+    """For templates without position-dependent rendering (Qwen2.5), the fixed prefix-based
+    tokenization must produce exactly the same tokens (and loss mask) as the previous
+    per-message implementation."""
+    tokenizer, dataset = build_dataset(model_path, reasoning_data_file)
+    item = dataset[0]
+
+    # Replicate the previous implementation: render each message in isolation, strip the
+    # system prompt tokens from every turn after the first, and pass tools on turn 0 only.
+    legacy_segments = []
+    for index, message in enumerate(MESSAGES):
+        inputs = apply_chat_template(
+            tokenizer,
+            messages=[message],
+            tools=TOOLS if index == 0 else None,
+            add_generation_prompt=False,
+            tokenize=True,
+            return_dict=True,
+            return_tensors="pt",
+        )
+        segment_ids = inputs["input_ids"][0]
+        if index != 0 and message["role"] != "system":
+            segment_ids = segment_ids[len(dataset.system_prompt) :]
+        if message["role"] == "assistant":
+            loss_mask = torch.ones_like(segment_ids)
+            loss_mask[: len(dataset.generation_prompt)] = 0
+        else:
+            loss_mask = torch.zeros_like(segment_ids)
+        legacy_segments.append((segment_ids, loss_mask))
+
+    legacy_input_ids = torch.cat([seg[0] for seg in legacy_segments])
+    legacy_loss_mask = torch.cat([seg[1] for seg in legacy_segments])
+
+    assert torch.equal(item["input_ids"], legacy_input_ids), (
+        "input_ids must be unchanged for templates without position-dependent rendering"
+    )
+    assert torch.equal(item["loss_mask"], legacy_loss_mask), "loss_mask must be unchanged"

+                return_dict=True,

+            prefix_len = prefix_ids.shape[0]
+
+            inputs = apply_chat_template(
+                processor,
+                messages=full_message[: index + 1],
+                tools=tools,
+                add_generation_prompt=False,
+                tokenize=True,
+                return_dict=True,
+                return_tensors="pt",
+                **apply_chat_template_kwargs,
+            )
+            inputs = dict(inputs)
+            input_ids = inputs.pop("input_ids")[0]
+            attention_mask = inputs.pop("attention_mask")[0]
+

+            # token-level prefix of tokenizing the longer one (true for chat templates whose
+            # turns are delimited by special tokens). Templates violating this fall back to
+            # the sequence check in `sanity_check`.
+            if input_ids.shape[0] < prefix_len or not torch.equal(input_ids[:prefix_len], prefix_ids):

+            inputs = apply_chat_template(
